quote_caveats: The current public LCSC pages/search snapshots primarily expose USD prices; CNY values are intentionally left null rather than FX-converted.
Prices, MOQ and stock can change; MAX17853 and some passive reference-price entries were out of stock at the observed quote.
New quantity is charged by physical instance even if its MPN already appears elsewhere. Only C_BAL1..8 and R_BAL1..8 are zero incremental procurement because the existing instances are rewired.

The 43-part list is an independent pre-deduplication candidate. The separate AUP readback package and any parent-selected HCS74/LTC7001 shutdown package must be reconciled before a final board BOM total.
